confirmed.title: refund() writes a status outside the system
confirmed.label: INCONSISTENCY
confirmed.root_cause: refund assigns the literal 'refund_pending', which STATUS does not declare

impact.demonstrated: A refunded order holds a status no operation reads, exits or archives

confidence.basis: Direct source evidence plus a concrete trace through the operator

confirmed.recommendation: Declare refund_pending with its exits, or route refunds through a declared state

confirmed.title: deliver() accepts any status
confirmed.label: RISK
confirmed.root_cause: deliver writes delivered without reading the current status
confirmed.condition: deliver is called on an order that has not been shipped

impact.demonstrated: A draft order can be marked delivered without being paid or shipped

confidence.basis: Direct source evidence of the unguarded write

confirmed.recommendation: Guard deliver so only shipped orders can be delivered
